description: This file is a Spring configuration class for setting up a journal entry aggregation job within the Fineract project. It defines beans for job steps, a job flow, and dependencies related to journal entry aggregation.

classes.name: JournalEntryAggregationJobConfiguration
classes.description: Spring configuration class that defines the setup for the journal entry aggregation batch job, including job steps and execution flow.

methods.name: journalEntryAggregationSummaryStep
methods.description: Defines the step responsible for processing journal entry aggregation summaries, using a chunk-oriented reader and writer.

methods.name: journalEntryAggregationJobReader
methods.description: Creates and returns the reader component for the journal entry aggregation job.

methods.name: journalEntryAggregationTrackingStep
methods.description: Defines the step for tracking journal entry aggregation progress, implemented as a simple tasklet.

methods.name: journalEntryAggregation
methods.description: Constructs the entire job flow for journal entry aggregation, including conditional execution logic.
